query:
INSERT INTO asset_inventory_items (
            inventory_item_id,
            asset_id,
            laboratory_id,
            tracking_mode,
            serial_number,
            batch_number,
            quantity_on_hand,
            quantity_allocated,
            location_id,
            status,
            public_notes,
            internal_notes
        )
        VALUES (
            $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6,
            $7::double precision::numeric,
            $8::double precision::numeric,
            $9, $10, $11, $12
        )
        RETURNING
            inventory_item_id,
            asset_id,
            laboratory_id,
            tracking_mode,
            serial_number,
            batch_number,
            quantity_on_hand::double precision AS "quantity_on_hand!",
            quantity_allocated::double precision AS "quantity_allocated!",
            location_id,
            status,
            public_notes,
            internal_notes,
            created_at,
            updated_at,
            last_stocktake_at
